agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Web research: finds, compares and verifies information, products, prices, competitors and sources; replies with links.

agents.name: Coder
agents.role: Software: writes, fixes, reviews and runs code and scripts, and verifies the result works.

agents.name: Operator
agents.role: This Windows PC: files and folders, documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, installs and routine tasks.

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Writing: drafts emails, posts, product descriptions, documents and replies. Drafts only, never sends.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.role: Claude Code itself, with the owner's plugins, subagents and hooks: larger coding and review jobs that benefit from its planning workflows. Edits files and runs tests inside the projects folder; cannot push, deploy or delete folders. Each run is a Claude Code session the owner can open in the Claude app.

agents.name: Gemini
agents.role: Google's Gemini through Antigravity (the user's Google AI Pro plan): Google Search-grounded research, very long documents, and a second opinion from a different model family. Read-only: it can search and read files but cannot change anything.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Data analysis: reads spreadsheets and CSV files, checks the numbers and reports the findings in a few lines. Read-only.

agents.name: MyApp
agents.role: MyApp, project lead for the myapp codebase: knows its code, build and release rules. Never pushes or deploys without the go-ahead.

agents.name: Designer
agents.role: Visual design: mockups, colour and layout advice, image briefs.

agents.name: Support Desk
agents.role: Customer questions: drafts answers from the help pages. Drafts only, never sends.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.role: A read-only second opinion on plans, code and documents.

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Plans and schedules: breaks a goal into steps with dates.
